info.title: GauthierFitness — API Documentation
info.description:
**GauthierFitness REST API** — e-commerce store for customizable fitness products (apparel, accessories, nutrition).

## Conventions
- Authentication: **Laravel Sanctum** (`Bearer <token>`). The token is obtained via `POST /api/login` or `POST /api/register`.
- Format: JSON (`Accept: application/json`).
- Error codes:
  - `401` — unauthenticated
  - `403` — forbidden (e.g. another user's resource)
  - `404` — resource not found
  - `422` — invalid validation data
- Rate limiting: `POST /api/contact` is limited to 5 requests/minute/IP.

## Functional domains
- **Auth** — registration, login, logout, verification.
- **Catalog** — public products (paginated listing + detail).
- **Cart & Order** — cart management, Stripe payment, order tracking.
- **Customization** — 2D/3D personalization sessions + assets (logos, images).
- **AI** — image generation via OpenAI for custom designs.
- **Admin** — products, orders, stock (admin-only).

post.summary:
User login.
Authenticates a user via email/password and returns a Sanctum token

Register a new user
Creates a user account (non-admin by default)

Password reset request
Sends an email with a reset link if an account exists for that email

Password reset
Verifies the token received by email and changes the password

get.summary:
Current user profile.
Returns the authenticated user with their roles

patch.summary:
Update profile
Updates the authenticated user's contact and postal address details

post.summary:
Logout
Revokes the current Sanctum token. The next call will require a new login

post.summary:
Upload a logo (PNG/JPG/JPEG/WebP, ≤ 3 MB)
Stores the file in `storage/app/public/customization/logos/{user_id}/`

Upload a customization image (PNG/JPG/JPEG/WebP, ≤ 5 MB).
Stores the file in `storage/app/public/customization/images/{user_id}/`
Generate a design via OpenAI from a text prompt

422.description: Request rejected. Possible cases: product not customizable or not allowing AI; prompt rejected by moderation (`reason: prompt_flagged`); generated image rejected by moderation (`reason: image_flagged`). Form validation errors also return a 422.

examples: Votre demande ne respecte pas nos règles de contenu et ne peut pas être générée.

reason.description: Origin of the rejection: brand blocklist, prompt moderation, image generator refusal, or generated image moderation.

categories.description: Triggered moderation categories (e.g. violence, sexual, hate).

201.description: Design generated, validated by moderation, and persisted.

503.description: AI service (OpenAI) temporarily unavailable or unreachable.

examples: Le service de génération IA est temporairement indisponible. Veuillez réessayer dans un instant.
